purpose: Teach: リポート/フェーズ/読み取り/近づける/停め/遣っ/戻さ/増えれ

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 年次リポート、若い頃から手書きで書いた。
lines.en: I've always written the annual reports by hand, even when I was young.
lines.style: Quiet, measured reflection. Soft opening, as if recalling something distant. No rush. Gentle weight on the memory itself.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。経営、フェーズで区切って、進めています。
lines.en: Yes. We manage it phase by phase now, keeping things moving forward.
lines.style: Respectful nod in the voice. Clear and structured, but not rushed. Listening to the elder's rhythm. Steady confidence without overstepping.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 人の心の読み取り、長年磨いてきた。
lines.en: Learning to read people — that's something I've spent decades refining.
lines.style: Understated pride beneath the surface. Slow, deliberate pacing. The words land quietly but firmly. Slight pause before the summary.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 顧客に近づける、独自のスタイル、続けます。
lines.en: We'll keep pursuing that style — getting close to our customers in our own way.
lines.style: Firm but not hard. The word 'pursuing' carries intention. Respectful deference to what came before, but also his own resolve. Even tempo.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 運転、駐車場で停めるのも、慎重に。
lines.en: Even something as small as parking carefully — it matters. I've always been cautious about that.
lines.style: Understated, almost conversational. The example feels like it comes from lived experience. Warm, not pedantic. Trail off slightly, as if letting the listener draw their own conclusion.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 若手に、業務を遣ってもらう文化、根付かせています。
lines.en: We're building a culture where younger staff take on real responsibility. It's starting to take root.
lines.style: Quiet pride in the work. Deliberate pacing on 'responsibility.' Forward-facing but not impatient. The kind of certainty that doesn't need to shout.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 失敗、白紙に戻さず、伝統に組み込め。
lines.en: When you fail, don't erase it — weave it into what comes next. Make it part of the tradition.
lines.style: Quiet authority without weight. The words feel like they carry the force of experience. Slightly slower pace. Each phrase deliberate. Open ending — space for the wisdom to land.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 業績、増えれば、社員に還元します。
lines.en: When we do well, we share that success. The staff benefits from what we build together.
lines.style: Sincere closing. Steady, even tempo. The commitment feels genuine and grounded. Quiet confidence. Not a flourish — just the right place to land.
